I wanted my silence to let my sister know that I have something to do so don't expect me to help with the baby because I'm not going to. I slowly started speaking to my family again beginning with when we went to my grandma's house on the regularly scheduled night and I don't think my grandma and uncle knew that I haven't been speaking at all, so I responded over there and then the next day I spoke more in the house.
